tasks.subject: Task 3: Implement Rust project file operations

- Modify: `src-tauri/src/file_ops.rs` — full rewrite with project structs and commands
- Modify: `src-tauri/src/lib.rs` — register 3 new commands in invoke_handler

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `ProjectData` and `ProjectMetadata` structs with serde Serialize/Deserialize
- [ ] `read_project` opens ZIP, reads project.json + screenshot.png, returns ProjectData
- [ ] `write_project` creates ZIP with project.json + screenshot.png
- [ ] `delete_file` uses trash crate or fs::remove_file based on flag
- [ ] All commands registered in lib.rs invoke_handler

**Verify:** `cd src-tauri && cargo build 2>&1 | tail -3` → `Finished`

tasks.subject: Task 5: Create project-store.ts with dirty tracking
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create a Zustand store that manages project state — file path, dirty flag, open/close — and watches canvas/annotation/background stores for changes.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/stores/project-store.ts`
- Create: `src/stores/__tests__/project-store.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Tracks `filePath`, `isDirty`, `isOpen`
- [ ] `markDirty()` called automatically when canvas, annotation, or background stores change
- [ ] `markClean()` resets dirty flag (called after save/open)
- [ ] `openProject(path)` sets filePath, marks clean, sets isOpen
- [ ] `closeProject()` cleans up and sets isOpen to false
- [ ] Dirty tracking stops when no project is open

**Verify:** `npx vitest run src/stores/__tests__/project-store.test.ts` → all 5 tests pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/stores/project-store.ts", "src/stores/__tests__/project-store.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run src/stores/__tests__/project-store.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Dirty flag tracks canvas/annotation/background changes", "openProject/setFilePath/closeProject work correctly", "State transitions: open → dirty → clean → closed"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Create use-file-menu.ts hook
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create a hook that listens for the five Tauri File menu events and orchestrates the corresponding actions — open project, save, export, close, delete.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/utils/project-io.ts` — shared project I/O utilities
- Create: `src/hooks/use-file-menu.ts` — menu event handler hook

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Listens for menu-file-open, menu-file-save, menu-file-export, menu-file-close, menu-file-delete
- [ ] Open: native dialog → readProject → restoreProjectFromData → all stores restored
- [ ] Save: buildProjectMetadata → writeProject (or save dialog if new)
- [ ] Export: delegates to useExport().saveAs() via ref
- [ ] Close: auto-saves if dirty + filePath → clears all stores
- [ ] Delete: opens DeleteConfirmModal via callback
- [ ] Cleans up event listeners on unmount

**Verify:** `npx tsc --noEmit` → no errors

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/hooks/use-file-menu.ts", "src/utils/project-io.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["All 5 menu events handled", "Open restores all stores", "Save serializes current state", "Export delegates to saveAs", "Close auto-saves then clears", "Delete opens modal"]}
```
